markets.label: Singapore — the cross-border hub
markets.summary: Singapore is the region's premier air and sea hub and the gateway to a ring of short cross-border escapes — Batam and Bintan in the Riau islands, Desaru on the Johor coast and Tioman up the Malaysian peninsula. Today these are slow diesel ferries or Causeway-jammed drives; several of the corridors are already mapped, making Singapore the readiest cross-border launch.

hero.title: AirAsia MOVE x Navier — Singapore
hero.subtitle: Across the strait to Batam, Bintan, Desaru and Tioman, on a foil.
hero.what_we_do_together: AirAsia MOVE owns the Singapore arrival and the onward booking; Navier adds the foiling cross-border tier — Batam, Bintan, Desaru and Tioman — booked in the same trip, with several corridors already mapped and ready.

partner_context.their_ambition: Singapore is a flagship MOVE hub; the cross-border resort escapes are exactly the onward leg AirAsia wants in the same booking as the flight.
partner_context.their_pressure: Batam, Bintan, Desaru and Tioman are short sea crossings strangled by once-a-day ferries and Causeway congestion — premium escapes throttled by slow boats and border traffic.
partner_context.where_navier_fits: A foiling tier turns each cross-border crossing into a clean AirAsia Ride leg, sold at checkout — and three of these corridors are already mapped and ready to bind.

markets.why_now: Singapore is the region's busiest hub and the natural cross-border gateway; the Batam, Bintan and Desaru corridors are already mapped, so the launch geometry is largely in place.

why_navier_now.step_change: Hydrofoiling lifts the hull clear of the water, so a Navier vessel flies instead of plowing through chop — roughly 10x more efficient than a conventional planing boat, faster at 30+ kt cruise, and dramatically smoother and quieter. It's software-defined and autonomy-ready, so the same fleet keeps improving over time.
why_navier_now.no_new_infrastructure: The boats use existing ferry terminals and marinas — no new terminals, dredging or shore power build-out required to start.
why_navier_now.the_moment: Singapore is the region's premier hub and the gateway to the Riau islands, Desaru and Tioman — all short sea crossings strangled by once-a-day ferries and Causeway jams. AirAsia MOVE can sell the cross-border water leg inside the same booking as the flight, with several of these corridors already mapped and ready.

markets.multimodal_fit: Flight into Singapore (AirAsia network) -> AirAsia Ride to the ferry terminal -> Navier foiling cross-border crossing to the islands or resort coast -> arrival. One booking, gate to jetty.
